name: GitHub PR Desk
tagline: One weekday digest of every PR, issue and comment across your repos
description: Each weekday morning it sweeps the repositories you name for pull requests, issues and comment threads that appeared since the last look, then lands everything in a single digest. Every open PR gets a priority read on how much attention it actually needs, so the review queue starts sorted instead of overwhelming.
author: MichaelGannotti
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
